svg.title: iPAQ silver keyboard expansion sleeve, UK QWERTY
svg.desc: Front compositing view, redrawn as vectors from the owner’s photographs on a centimetre cutting grid. Legends are outlines. Sleeve openings show what the empty part shows: the GPS sleeve’s inner back shell, or nothing through the open-framed keyboard sleeve. Dimensions outside the standard 42.8 mm CF width are photo estimates.

rect.data-evidence: Owner’s photograph: horizontal dark window below Z, above left arrow
